d:
These are all the perks, traits, reputation, SPECIAL, skills, and misc. icons from Forno and VK's Sexy Vault Girl Interface- Official Release mod for Fallout New Vegas, taken from the mod files, formatted, and captioned by myself for easy viewing.
These assets were created by a talented artist named Forno, who has retired from the internet and has no interest in continuing to work on mod content. I'm uploading this to share my appreciation for his charming art style and sense of humor. If you enjoy his work, remember to support human artists, without whom we have nothing.
n: [Image Set] Sexy Vault Girl Interface (Fallout) | Forno
